name: slop-guard
description: Prevents, detects and gates security, performance and maintainability anti-patterns in agent-written code.

stop_gate.title: Block turn end on unresolved blockers
stop_gate.description: Run slow checks at Stop and keep Claude working while blockers remain.

require_docs_lookup.title: Require Context7 documentation lookup
require_docs_lookup.description: Warn when a framework or new dependency is used without a Context7 lookup in the same session.

dependency_freshness.title: Dependency freshness enforcement
dependency_freshness.description: off | warn | error — how to surface too-fresh or outdated pinned dependencies.

dependency_cooldown_days.title: Dependency cooldown window (days)
dependency_cooldown_days.description: Versions published within this many days are flagged as too-fresh (supply-chain risk).
